pretreatments.description: Mechanical chopping of Napier grass to a particle size of approximately 5 cm × 5 cm
Ensiling of chopped Napier grass in a closed container by self-fermentation for two weeks to produce silage
Mechanical grinding in a food blender until materials could pass through a 40-mesh screen (less than 0.425 mm)
Organosolv pretreatment using 50% (v/v) aqueous ethanol at 190 °C for reaction times of 15, 30, 45, and 60 min, with or without the addition of 1% (w/w) H2SO4, HCl, CH3COOH, or NaOH as catalysts
Hydrothermal pretreatment using distilled water at 190 °C for reaction times of 15, 30, 45, and 60 min, with or without the addition of 1% (w/w) H2SO4, HCl, CH3COOH, or NaOH as catalysts
Enzymatic hydrolysis using Cellic® CTec2 at 20 filter paper unit (FPU)/g-substrate in 50 mM sodium citrate buffer at pH 5.0, conducted at 50 °C and 150 rpm for 72 h
